title: Demographic Probing of Large Language Models Lacks Construct Validity

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual manipulation of implicit and explicit racial cues (first names, African American Vernacular English dialect, dialog histories, and explicit demographic descriptors) in first-person advice-seeking prompts to compare model outputs and assess construct validity between Black and White demographic groups.

Counterfactual manipulation of implicit and explicit gender cues (first names, dialog histories, and explicit demographic descriptors) in first-person advice-seeking prompts to compare model outputs and assess construct validity between male and female demographic groups.
